words.text: Telefonunun yedeklemesi açıksa Android bu dosyaları ve oyun hesabının oturumunu kendi yedeğine katabilir. Telefon bu yedekten geri yüklenirse ya da oyunu yedeği alınmış bir telefona Google Play’den yeniden kurarsan aynı hesaba girilir.
words.note: Privacy card, paragraph 4 (approved text: keep every fact). Changed 2026-10-27 (draft of 2026-10-27, waiting for the owner's approval; the approved text of 2026-10-16 said only that Android may add these files to its backup): Android's backup also keeps the game account's session (Unity's PlayerPrefs, unity/Assets/Editor/ManifestBackupRules.cs), so the phone restored from it, or the game reinstalled from Google Play on a phone that was backed up, gets back into the same account (T566).

words.text: Satın alma altyapısı Unity’nindir. Her satın alma denemesinde Unity’ye ürün, fiyat, mağazanın fişi, telefonunun modeli ve dili, iPhone ve iPad’de de Apple’ın cihaza verdiği uygulama kimliği gider; Unity bunları kendi mali kayıtları, yasal yükümlülükleri ve sahtekârlığı önlemek için kullanır. Bulut kaydı açıkken aynı altyapı, oyun Unity’ye bağlandığında Unity’den kendi ayarlarını ister (Unity’nin bu kuruluma verdiği kimlikle ve oyunun sürümüyle) ve hesabına her girişte Unity’ye bir giriş bildirimi gönderir: oyuncu kodun, Unity’nin bu kuruluma verdiği kimlikler, telefonunun modeli, işletim sisteminin sürümü, dili ve bölge ayarları, depolama alanının büyüklüğü ve açıldığı an, oyunun sürümü, kurulduğu an ve bir mağazadan kurulup kurulmadığı. Reklam kimliği gitmez. Bu gönderimler kapatılamaz; Bulut kaydı kapalıyken yalnız satın alma denemelerindekiler gider.
words.note: Privacy card, the paragraph on Unity's purchase events (draft of 2026-10-24 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval: keep every fact; Aptabase, Unity, Google Play and App Store are names). Changed 2026-10-27 (draft of 2026-10-27 after the phone run of 27 October, waiting for the owner's approval): with the cloud save on, Unity's purchase library also asks Unity for its settings as the game connects (the installation's ID, the game's version) and sends a sign-in notice at every sign-in (player code, Unity's installation IDs, the phone's model, system version, language and region settings, storage size and boot time, the game's version, install time and whether it came from a store; no advertising ID); none of it can be turned off; with the cloud save off only the purchase attempts' events go (T186, docs/research/server-v1.md section 6.1).

words.text: İzin verirsen oyun, Aptabase adlı ölçüm hizmetine nasıl oynandığını anlatan kısa notlar gönderir: oyunun açılması, oynadığın bölüm, kazanıp kazanmadığın ve kaç hamle kaldığı, tamamladığın tablo ve oda, mağazanın açılması ve mağazada ne aldığın (ödeme bilgisi olmadan). Her notta zamanı ve yalnızca o oturuma ait rastgele bir numara olur; oyunun sürümü, telefonunun işletim sistemi ve dili de gider. Aptabase notları Avrupa Birliği’nde sayar; bağlantının IP adresinden yaklaşık konumunu (ülke ve bölge) çıkarır ve IP adresini saklamaz.
words.note: Privacy card, the paragraph on the play statistics: what the notes hold and where they go (draft of 2026-10-24 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval: keep every fact; Aptabase, Unity, Google Play and App Store are names; the list matches PlayNote.cs). Changed 2026-10-25 (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval): says that Aptabase works out the player's approximate location (country and region) from the connection, as the Play Data safety form (Approximate location) and the App Store label (Coarse Location) declare.

words.text: Notlarda adın, e-postan, reklam kimliğin ya da telefonunu tanıyan bir kimlik yoktur. İzin vermezsen oyun aynen çalışır. Kararını Ayarlar’daki Oyun istatistikleri anahtarıyla istediğin zaman değiştirebilirsin.
words.note: Privacy card, after the statistics: what the notes never hold, and that the choice changes on the settings card (draft of 2026-10-24 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval: keep every fact; Aptabase, Unity, Google Play and App Store are names).

words.text: Oyunu silip yeniden kurarsan ya da telefon değiştirirsen ilerlemen ve altının yalnız iki yoldan geri gelir: hesabın Google Play Games’e ya da Game Center’a bağlıysa bulut kaydından, değilse telefonunun yedeğinden (yedekleme açıksa ve yedek alınmışsa). İkisi de yoksa oyun baştan başlar ve eski kayıt bulunamaz. Ayarlar’daki Verilerimi sil ile buluttaki hesabını ve kaydını istediğin zaman silebilirsin; telefondaki ilerlemeyi de silip silmeyeceğini sen seçersin. Sahtekârlığı önlemek için satın almaların kimliksiz bir izi 36 ay saklanır. Satın alma iadesini Google Play’den ya da Apple’dan istersin.
words.note: Privacy card, last paragraph: what comes back after a reinstall or on a new phone, deleting the data, the 36-month trace, and refunds (draft of 2026-10-27 for v1 with the cloud save, docs/research/server-v1.md section 6.5, waiting for the owner's approval: keep every fact; Unity, Unity Gaming Services, Google Play, Google Play Games, Game Center, App Store and Apple are names). Changed 2026-10-27 (draft of 2026-10-27 after the phone run of 27 October, waiting for the owner's approval): the progress comes back in only two ways, the cloud save with Google Play Games or Game Center linked, or the phone's backup; "on the same phone" was false, a reinstall gave a new account at level 1 (T566).

Tutorial, the first painting made whole on its jigsaw, first line under the lit painting.
Tutorial, the first painting, second line: a room's five paintings restore it.
Tutorial, the small last line of a step that is only looked at: a touch anywhere goes on.
Booster intro, the level the spatula opens on, first line while its lit disc waits to be touched ("disk" is the round button on the shelf).
Booster intro, the level the row brush opens on, first line while its lit disc waits to be touched.
Booster intro, the level the column brush opens on, first line while its lit disc waits to be touched.
Booster intro, the level the shuffle opens on, first line while its lit disc waits to be touched (touching it deals the tiles anew).
Booster intro, first line once the spatula is picked up: touch the one lit tile on the board.
Booster intro, first line once the row brush is picked up: touch the lit row anywhere.
Booster intro, first line once the column brush is picked up: touch the lit column anywhere.
Booster intro, small last line: this first use of the new booster costs nothing (the player's own stock is not touched).

words.text: Seçersen bölüme fırça ve sıçramayla başlarsın
words.note: Start boosters intro on the level card after a lost level, under the lit brush-and-splash disc: what choosing it does.
Start boosters intro, under the lit rainbow palette disc: what choosing it does.
Start boosters intro, under the lit extra moves disc: what choosing it does. {moves} is the number of extra moves.
Small last line of the card a long press on a booster opens (it shows what the booster does): a touch anywhere closes it.

words.text: Bir booster'ı basılı tutarsan ne yaptığını yeniden izlersin
words.note: Booster intro, once, right after the first booster used by hand: its disc is lit and this one sentence says that holding (a long press on) any booster's round button shows again what it does. "basılı tutmak" = to press and hold.
Entry page shown as the game starts: the game's title under the palette. It is a working title (see EntryWorkingTitle); translate it as a short game title.
Entry page: the small badge under the title that says the title is only a working title, in small capitals.
Entry page: the line under the title, what the game is about. "onarmak" = to restore (a painting).
Entry page: the line under the bar that fills while the game starts. {percent} is a whole number from 0 to 100; Turkish writes the sign before it.
Entry page: the line that pulses once the bar is full; a touch anywhere opens the museum.
Entry page, foot, left: the studio's name. A name: the same in every language.
Entry page, foot, right: the game's version and that this is a test build: the stand-in build, which sells nothing for money. {version} is the version, "1.0".

Entry page: what the line under the bar says instead of the share when the game could not start (a file it needs could not be read). The player is to close the game and open it again; short, one line.
Name of the starter pack (coins and one start booster of each kind, sold once): "the apprentice's bag".
Shop, on the top edge of the starter pack's frame (small capitals): it is sold to a player only once.
Shop: a pack's button while the store has not said its price yet. Keep the ellipsis.
Shop: the button of a coin pack the store does not sell now.
Shop, in the coins' panel instead of the buttons: the phone's app store (Google Play, App Store) cannot be reached now. Calm, no blame.
Shop, the link under the panels (iPhone and iPad only): asks the App Store for the player's purchases back (Apple's "Restore Purchases").
Name of the smallest coin pack: a pouch of coins.
Name of the second coin pack: a bag of coins.
Name of the third coin pack: a chest of coins.
Name of the largest coin pack: a treasure of coins.
Card before paying, first line: asks whether to buy. {price} is the price as the store writes it in the player's currency ("₺89,99").

words.text: Ödemeyi mağaza alır; satın alma bilgisi Unity’ye de gider.
words.note: Card before paying, second line: the phone's app store takes the payment, and Unity, whose purchase library the game uses, is told of the purchase too.
Card before paying: the green button that opens the store's payment sheet.
Card before paying: the blue button that closes it without paying.
Card while the store takes the payment: its nameplate.
Card while the store takes the payment, first line.
Second line of the cards whose payment is not made yet: what was bought arrives once it is paid.
Card after a payment, first line: the coins arrived. {coins} is the amount.
Card after a payment, second line under the coins.
Card when the payment waits for someone's approval (a parent's "Ask to Buy") or for cash at a shop: its nameplate.
Card when the payment waits for approval, first line.
Card when a purchase came to nothing: its nameplate.
Second line of the card when a purchase came to nothing: no money was taken.
That card, first line: the store cannot be reached now.

words.text: Bu ürün şu anda satışta değil.
words.note: That card, first line: the store does not sell this product now.
That card, first line: the starter pack is sold once and the player has it. {name} is its name.
That card, first line: the store did not take the payment.

words.text: Bunun için bir ödeme zaten bekliyor.
words.note: That card, first line: a payment for this product is waiting already.
Card after asking the store for the purchases back: its nameplate.
That card, first line: the starter pack came back. {name} is its name.

words.text: Geri yüklenecek bir satın alma yok.
words.note: That card, first line: there was nothing to bring back.

words.text: Altın paketleri geri gelmez; yalnız {name} gelir.
words.note: That card, second line: coin packs bought before are not restored, only the starter pack. {name} is its name.
That card, first line: the store did not answer.
That card, second line: try again later.
Build line: things are sold for money through the phone's app store.

Shop, in the coins' panel instead of the buttons: this run of the game cannot keep what it gives (its saved progress could not be read, or a later version of the game wrote it), so nothing is sold until the game is opened again. Calm, no blame, short; one line in the panel (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval).

Card of a payment the store has not answered (the connection to the store was lost while its payment sheet was up, or it has been silent for half a minute), first line: no answer has come yet. Never say that nothing was paid: the payment may still go through, and the second line says it comes once paid (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval).

Entry page, foot, right: the game's version alone, for a build that sells through the phone's app store (no test build). {version} is the version, "1.0" (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval; the final wording is the owner's).

Settings card, under the foot: what kind of build this is, for a build that sells through the phone's app store, which is no test build. {ads} is "reklamlar canlandırma" and {buying} "satın alma mağazadan" (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval; the final wording is the owner's).

Credits card, a heading: the software the game carries from others (the play statistics' library, the JSON reader, the app stores' purchase libraries); the lines under it stay in English (draft of 2026-10-25 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval).

Card when linking did not work, its nameplate: could not link. (draft of 2026-10-26 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval; the final wording is the owner's)

That card, first line: {platform} is not available on this phone (not installed, turned off). {platform} is a name. (draft of 2026-10-26 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval; the final wording is the owner's)

First line of the cards when linking or going over to another save failed for the network or the service: cannot connect right now. (draft of 2026-10-26 for v1, waiting for the owner's approval; the final wording is the owner's)

words.text: Oyun senin için görünmez bir oyuncu hesabı açar. Adını, e-postanı ya da bir parola sormaz; hesabı rastgele bir oyuncu kimliği tanır. İlerlemen, cüzdanın ve satın almalarının listesi bu hesapta, Unity Gaming Services’in sunucularında saklanır; Unity bu hizmeti bizim adımıza verir. Hesap Google Play Games’e ya da Game Center’a bağlıysa ya da telefonunun yedeği geri yüklenirse, oyunu yeniden kurduğunda ya da telefon değiştirdiğinde kaldığın yerden sürersin; ikisi de yoksa oyun baştan başlar. İnternet yokken oyun aynen oynanır; kayıt bağlantı gelince eşitlenir. Ayarların, istatistik iznin ve deneme kayıtların bulut kaydına girmez. Bulut kaydını Ayarlar’daki Bulut kaydı anahtarıyla kapatabilirsin; o zaman oyun hesaba bağlanmaz ve hiçbir şey eşitlenmez.
words.note: Privacy card, the paragraph on the cloud save and the invisible account (draft of 2026-10-27 for v1 with the cloud save, docs/research/server-v1.md section 6.5, waiting for the owner's approval: keep every fact; Unity, Unity Gaming Services, Google Play, Google Play Games, Game Center, App Store and Apple are names). Changed 2026-10-27 (draft of 2026-10-27 after the phone run of 27 October, waiting for the owner's approval): the progress comes back after a reinstall or on a new phone only with Google Play Games or Game Center linked, or from the phone's backup, otherwise the game starts over (T566); the settings, the statistics choice and the attempt records are not part of the cloud save (they do go into the phone's own backup, paragraph 4).

words.text: Telefonunda Google Play Games (iPhone ve iPad’de Game Center) açıksa hesabın ona bağlanır. Bunun için Google ya da Apple, bu oyundaki oyuncu kimliğini Unity’ye doğrular; adın, e-postan ve arkadaş listen oyuna gelmez. Bağlamazsan hesabına yalnız bu telefondan ya da bu telefonun yedeği yüklenen bir telefondan girilir.
words.note: Privacy card, the paragraph on Google Play Games and Game Center (draft of 2026-10-27 for v1 with the cloud save, docs/research/server-v1.md section 6.5, waiting for the owner's approval: keep every fact; Unity, Unity Gaming Services, Google Play, Google Play Games, Game Center, App Store and Apple are names). Changed 2026-10-27 (draft of 2026-10-27, waiting for the owner's approval): an account not linked is reached from this phone, or from a phone set up from this phone's backup (T566).

words.text: Bir satın almanın gerçek olduğunu anlamak için oyun, mağazanın verdiği satın alma kaydını (ürün, sipariş kimliği, mağazanın imzalı kaydı) Unity’deki sunucu kodumuza gönderir. Sunucu bunu Google Play’e ya da Apple’a sorar ve sonucu hesabında saklar. İade edilen satın almalar bu listede işaretlenir.
